verdict.rationale: First-party sources say Svelte is a compiler that turns declarative components into efficient JavaScript that "surgically updates the DOM" and does minimal work in the browser. A community user corroborates that it compiles to imperative JavaScript, and another reports large performance and bundle-size gains after migrating from React. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement that no virtual DOM diffing occurs, and in-depth documentation of the fine-grained update mechanism.
